question: What practice concerning the soul has been declared to the addressee, and to whom is that declaration addressed?
premises: A practice of the soul is indicated.
That practice has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The details of the practice are not given in this verse alone.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
